rulesTestNames: lets guests read only their own form profile review rows
owner: Participant form profile view projector: profiles form profile view triggers
read: the guest gets and lists only rows whose uid is theirs, while their account is not deleted; a row not written yet reads as missing
write: server only; written from the proposal, its response and version, and the organizer card, deleted once the proposal is unavailable to its owner
migrationNotes: Each row holds the proposal and card parts the retired getParticipantFormProfile and listParticipantFormProfiles callables returned (Nov 2026), without organizer names. The participant-form-profile-views copy-forward migration creates rows for proposals recorded before the triggers.
